headline: Convert files on your computer
privacy: Your files stay on your computer. Nothing is uploaded to the internet.

docsLoGuideBody: Converte Fácil can install free LibreOffice for you. Windows may ask for permission. This is separate from the Converte Fácil installer and can take a few minutes.
docsLoGuideStep2: Approve the Windows permission prompt if it appears, then wait.
docsLoGuideStep3: When it finishes, document conversion unlocks automatically.
docsLoInstallProgress: Installing LibreOffice… please wait. Windows may ask for permission.
docsLoInstallSuccess: LibreOffice is ready. You can convert Word and Excel now.
docsLoInstallFailed: We could not install LibreOffice automatically. Try the download page, or install it yourself and click Check again.
docsWingetMissing: Automatic install needs Windows Package Manager (winget). Use the download page instead, then click Check again.
pdfHelp: Each page becomes one image file in a new subfolder next to your PDF.
pdfDropHint: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose a file
pdfQualityHelp: Normal matches the usual size and clarity. Small is lighter; High is sharper and larger.

errorDiskFull: There is not enough free space. Free some disk space and try again.
errorTooLarge: This file is too large to convert right now. Try a smaller file.
errorPdfEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Unlock it first, then try again.
